title: AppleSkin to 26.3, loaded in the client
text: Port one mod to 26.3 to a build, then to a loaded client. AppleSkin NeoForge 1.21.6 → 26.3 reaches a packaged build with the mixin audit in 66s: build settings, NeoGradle, Java and 82 → 0 compile errors are handled by rules except the removed debug-text event, one hand-written file. Loading it in a real 26.3 client is the next rung.
result: AppleSkin NeoForge 1.21.6 → 26.3 ports with no hand-written file and passes its HUD behaviour check in the real 26.3 client: the estimate for a golden carrot (+12.000002) matches real regeneration (+12.000001), and the same check fails when the estimate is broken on purpose. The debug-text event became a rule; a stale Parchment setting that compiled the 26.3 game wrong is now moved or removed by the port.
